reviews.comment: *396. Lemire is an amazing professor. The class is very discussion heavy, so be prepared to actually read and be expected to talk to your classmates you sit by. Grading is a couple of essays, that's it, no exams. Attendance is mandatory and taken every class, but she's understanding if you have to miss.

An amazing professor to take ENGL 104 with, uses a free textbook, and gives amazing feedback and is very responsive over email. Is very understanding and willing to give exceptions or extensions when needed.

LeMire is incredibly caring for her students and is understanding when you ask for an extension or need to miss class. She is always available if you need to work with her or have any questions at all.

Sarah gives amazing feedback in the course and the grade you get is really dependent on how much time you put into the course. Also the text book is free. The class is very well organized and she is cares a lot about your success.

Prof LeMire is probably one of the most passionate and kind professors I have had. She is always so helpful and was sure to make sure we had the tools needed to get As. She does grade essays (4 total) fairly hard but is helpful in the editing process and office hours. Getting an A is very possible, but you have to work for it!! Take her!!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She is the absolute best! She is the sweetest prof/librarian. In this english class there was quite a few papers, but she always had us submit rough drafts and gave very good feedback. She was always super welcoming & helpful in office hours. 13/10 recommend if you have to take english 104.

Prof LeMire is so nice, she really cares about her students and for them to do good. If you reach out to her she will talk to you and help you. Would definitely take her again! There are no tests but there are 4 essays that come very fast.

Professor LeMire is easily one of my favorite professors here at A&M! She really cares about each of her students success and makes herself available for office hours and appointments. We wrote 4 papers over the course of the semester and she provides feedback after each one. Would definitely recommend to take this course!

Professor LeMire was an absolutely amazing professor, and I highly recommend anyone who is thinking of taking an English course to take it with her. With every single assignment she made sure we knew exactly what was needed of us and even went above and beyond to help us out after class
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Inspirational--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Before calling her a great professor, I want to say that she makes an amazing friend and person first. She is so caring, warm, and genuine. She really wants to see you succeed. I was so lucky to have her as one of my university's first professors. She is very knowledgeable and passionate in her subject of English. Take her!

Professor LeMire was the best professor I've had at Texas A&M. She cares about her students and makes sure each person in her course feels welcome. We write 4 papers over the semester, but she makes sure everyone has the potential of receiving an A because she gives amazing feedback. I would most definitely take this course again. I recommend her!
